title: Inconsistent currency display across accommodation offers (USD $ and KRW ₩ mixed on the same page despite USD $ selected)
environment: Production · Desktop (macOS) · Chrome · en-US · Selected Currency: USD $
steps_to_reproduce: Sign in at https://goodnstay.com/en-US using the test account (baominh.internship@gmail.com).
Verify that the top navigation bar currency selector is set to USD $.
Open the Accommodation Request page (Request 1: Seoul, 3 nights, 1 guest, 1 room).
Navigate to the 'HOTELS ARE MAKING OFFERS' section on the right panel.
Compare the Total price and currency symbols across all accommodation offers and inspect Chrome DevTools (F12 -> Console & Network).
actual_result: Only 1 offer displays in USD ($212.52) while the remaining 4 offers display unconverted prices in KRW (₩19,430 / ₩8,349 / ₩12,903 / ₩7,590) despite USD ($) being selected.
expected_result: All accommodation offers on the page should display prices converted consistently into the user's selected currency (USD $), or exchange rates (/api/payment/fx-rates?base=USD) must be fetched on initial page load.

evidence.console: No uncaught JS error (silent fallback in useFormattedPrice when exchangeRates['KRW'] is undefined).
evidence.network: GET /api/traveler/request-bids?requestStatus=open -> 200 OK; GET /api/payment/fx-rates?base=USD -> NOT FIRED on initial page load.
